parameters.help_en: The custom format of access logs. This parameter is available only if you enable access log. The value must be a JSON string that contains the following keys: authority_for, bytes_received, bytes_sent, downstream_local_address, downstream_remote_address, duration, istio_policy_status, method, path, protocol, requested_server_name, response_code, response_flags, route_name, start_time, trace_id, upstream_cluster, upstream_host, upstream_local_address, upstream_service_time, upstream_transport_failure_reason, user_agent, and x_forwarded_for

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to use an existing certificate authority (CA) certificate and private key
parameters.help_zh: 使用已有的CA证书和私钥
parameters.name: use_existing_ca

parameters.example: Ca cert content, base64 encoding format
parameters.help_en: The CA certificate in Base64-encoded format. This parameter is typically used to migrate a self-managed Istio cluster to ASM. The value corresponds to the content of the ca-cert.pem file in the istio-ca-secret secret, which is in the istio-system namespace of the self-managed Istio cluster
parameters.help_zh: CA证书（Base64 Encode格式），该参数一般用于自建Istio迁移ASM的场景下，对应自建Istio集群的istio-system命名空间下名称为istio-ca-secret的secret的ca-cert.pem文件内容
parameters.name: existing_ca_cert

parameters.example: Ca key content, base64 encoding format
parameters.help_en: The CA private key in Base64-encoded format. This parameter is typically used to migrate a self-managed Istio cluster to ASM. The value corresponds to the content of the ca-key.pem file in the istio-ca-secret secret, which is in the istio-system namespace of the self-managed Istio cluster
parameters.help_zh: CA Key（Base64 Encode格式）。该参数一般用于自建Istio迁移ASM的场景下，对应自建Istio集群的istio-system命名空间下名称为istio-ca-secret的secret的ca-key.pem文件内容
parameters.name: existing_ca_key

parameters.help_en:
The type of the existing certificate:

1: A self-signed certificate of Istiod. This corresponds to the istio-ca-secret secret in the istio-system namespace. If you use this type, you must also provide the `ExistingCaCert` and `ExsitingCaKey` parameters.

2: An external certificate of Istiod. For more information, see plugin ca cert (https://istio.io/latest/docs/tasks/security/cert-management/plugin-ca-cert/). This generally corresponds to the cacerts secret in the istio-system namespace. If you use this type, you must also provide the `ExisingRootCaCert` and `ExisingRootCaKey` parameters
parameters.help_zh:
已有的证书类型： 

1：Istiod自签证书。对应istio-system命名空间下名称为istio-ca-secret的secret。若使用该类型，还需要提供`ExistingCaCert` 和`ExsitingCaKey`两个参数。

2：Istiod外部证书。详情请参见plugin ca cert (https://istio.io/latest/docs/tasks/security/cert-management/plugin-ca-cert/)。一般对应为istio-system命名空间下名称为cacerts的secret。 若使用该类型，还需要提供`ExisingRootCaCert`和`ExisingRootCaKey`两个参数
parameters.name: existing_ca_type

parameters.example: Root certificate content in base64 encoding
parameters.help_en: The existing root certificate
parameters.help_zh: 已有的根证书
parameters.name: existing_root_ca_cert

parameters.example: Root key content, base64 encoding format
parameters.help_en: The private key that corresponds to the existing root certificate
parameters.help_zh: 已有的根证书对应的私钥
parameters.name: existing_root_ca_key

parameters.help_en: The certificate chain from the CA certificate to the root certificate. The chain must contain at least two certificates
parameters.help_zh: 从CaCert到RootCert的证书链，至少包含两个证书
parameters.name: cert_chain

parameters.help_en: When you create a Service Mesh instance, you can add a cluster to the instance. If you do not specify this parameter, no cluster is added. The cluster must be in the same VPC and vSwitch as the Service Mesh instance, and must have the same domain name
parameters.help_zh: 创建网格时可以选择一个集群加入网格，为空时不会添加集群。该集群需要和网格在同一个VPC的同一个VSwitch中，且集群域名相同
parameters.name: guest_cluster

parameters.help_en:
The tags to add to the Service Mesh instance. The following information is included:

key: The tag key.

value: The tag value
parameters.help_zh:
给服务网格实例打tag标签。包含以下信息：

key：标签名称。

value：标签值
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the Ambient Mesh mode for the Service Mesh instance
parameters.help_zh: 是否为服务网格实例启用Ambient Mesh模式
parameters.name: enable_ambient

parameters.help_en:
The playground scenario. If you specify this parameter, an ASM playground instance is created. Valid value:

ewmaLb: the exponentially weighted moving average (EWMA) load balancing scenario
parameters.help_zh:
Playground场景，指定该值将创建ASM Playground实例，可选值：
ewmaLb: ewma负载均衡场景
parameters.name: playground_scene

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable the ACMG mode
parameters.help_zh: 是否启用ACMG模式
parameters.name: enable_acmg
